name: webhookwidget-starter
description: A Webhook Widget endpoint on Cloudflare Workers: your data, on your iPhone's Home Screen

WIDGET_TOKEN.description: The Bearer token Webhook Widget sends with every request. Leave as "foobar" to try it right away; before showing private data, replace it with a long random string and treat it like a password (Worker -> Settings -> Variables and Secrets -> Edit WIDGET_TOKEN).
